nodes.name: Core
nodes.description: Foundation modules: app shell, routing, API access, types, utilities, and styles

nodes.name: App (Root Module)
nodes.description: Root component and entry point. Creates per-instance QueryClient (useState), wraps Outlet in QueryClientProvider. Applies persisted theme class on mount via useEffect reading Zustand store imperatively. Exports Layout (html/head/body shell with Meta, Links, Scripts, ScrollRestoration), App (default export with providers), and ErrorBoundary (404 and generic error display).

nodes.name: Route Config
nodes.description: Declarative route tree. Root layout at "/" wraps home (index) and products/:category? routes. Checkout and success are top-level routes outside the root layout (no header/nav).

nodes.name: API Client
nodes.description: ky HTTP client instance with prefixUrl set to https://dummyjson.com

nodes.name: Type Definitions
nodes.description: Shared domain types -- Category, Product, CartItem

nodes.name: Utility Functions
nodes.description: cn() for Tailwind class merging (clsx + tailwind-merge), fromSlugToTitle() for URL slug to title case

nodes.name: Global Styles
nodes.description: TailwindCSS v4 entry point. Imports tw-animate-css. Defines custom dark variant, slide-down/slide-up animations for Radix Collapsible, oklch color tokens for light and dark themes (shadcn/ui neutral palette), and base layer styles.

nodes.name: Stores (Zustand)
nodes.description: Client-side state managed by Zustand with localStorage persistence

nodes.name: Cart Store
nodes.description: Zustand store with persist middleware (localStorage key: "cart-storage"). Manages cart items array, computed total, and successfulOrder flag. Actions: addItem (upsert), removeItem, incrementItem, decrementItem, clear. Total is recomputed on every mutation via reduce.

nodes.name: Theme Store
nodes.description: Zustand store with persist middleware (localStorage key: "theme-storage"). Tracks theme as "dark" | "light" | "system". setTheme action mutates document.documentElement classList directly for immediate CSS variable switch.

nodes.name: Queries (TanStack Query)
nodes.description: Server-state management via TanStack Query hooks and query options for SSR prefetch

nodes.name: Categories Query
nodes.description: Shared query for all product categories. queryKey: ["categories"]. Fetches GET /products/categories from DummyJSON. Returns Category[]. Used in root-layout SSR prefetch and nav-menu client rendering. Exports both queryOptions object (for SSR prefetch) and useCategoriesQuery hook.

nodes.name: Category Sections Infinite Query
nodes.description: Infinite query for home page category sections. queryKey: ["category-sections"]. Pages through categories in batches of 4, fetching 4 products per category via GET /products/category/:slug. Includes artificial 800ms delay for loading UX. Depends on categories query data for pagination bounds.

nodes.name: Products Infinite Query
nodes.description: Infinite query for products listing. queryKey: ["products", category]. Fetches GET /products or /products/category/:slug with limit=8 and cursor-based pagination via skip param. Supports optional category filter.

nodes.name: Shared Components
nodes.description: Reusable components used across multiple routes

nodes.name: ProductCard
nodes.description: Reusable product display card with image, title, price, and "Add to cart" button. Fires onAddToCart callback and shows sonner toast on click. data-testid="product-card" for E2E targeting.

nodes.name: ThemeToggle
nodes.description: Dark/light theme toggle button using lucide Sun/Moon icons with CSS transition animations. Reads and writes theme store. Binary toggle (dark <-> light), does not cycle through system.

nodes.name: UI Primitives (shadcn/ui)
nodes.description: Low-level UI components from shadcn/ui built on Radix UI primitives

nodes.name: Breadcrumb
nodes.description: Accessible breadcrumb navigation (nav, ol, li) with separator and ellipsis support. Uses Radix Slot for asChild composition.

nodes.name: Button
nodes.description: Button with 6 variants (default, destructive, outline, secondary, ghost, link) and 4 sizes (default, sm, lg, icon). Uses CVA for variant styling and Radix Slot for asChild polymorphism.

nodes.name: Collapsible
nodes.description: Animated expand/collapse using Radix Collapsible primitive with slide-down/slide-up CSS animations

nodes.name: Input
nodes.description: Styled text input with focus ring, validation states, and dark mode support

nodes.name: NavigationMenu
nodes.description: Full Radix NavigationMenu primitive wrapper with trigger, content, link, viewport, and indicator sub-components. Supports viewport and non-viewport modes.

nodes.name: Sheet
nodes.description: Slide-over panel built on Radix Dialog. Supports 4 sides (top, right, bottom, left). Includes overlay, portal, header, footer, title, description, and close button.

nodes.name: Toaster
nodes.description: Sonner toast notifications themed via theme store and CSS variables

nodes.name: Root Layout
nodes.description: Layout route at "/". Server-side loader prefetches categories query and dehydrates QueryClient for SSR hydration. Renders Header + Outlet wrapped in TanStack Query HydrationBoundary.

nodes.name: Header
nodes.description: Sticky top header with backdrop blur. Contains NavMenu (left), centered Logo, and Cart + ThemeToggle (right).

nodes.name: Logo
nodes.description: "ShopHub" brand logo linking to home page

nodes.name: NavMenu
nodes.description: Left-side Sheet drawer navigation. Lists "All Products" link and all categories from categories query. First 10 categories shown by default, rest in a Collapsible "See All/See Less" toggle. Auto-closes on navigation state change.

nodes.name: Cart Sheet
nodes.description: Right-side Sheet drawer showing cart contents. Displays CartItem list with increment/decrement/remove controls, total, and "Checkout" link. Shows EmptyState when cart is empty. data-testid="cart-button" on trigger.

nodes.name: CartItem
nodes.description: Single cart line item with product image, title, computed price, quantity controls, and remove button

nodes.name: Cart EmptyState
nodes.description: Empty cart placeholder with shopping cart icon and instructional text

nodes.name: Home Page
nodes.description: Index route at "/". Server-side loader fetches categories then prefetches first page of category sections (4 categories x 4 products each). Infinite scroll via react-intersection-observer triggers fetchNextPage when sentinel enters viewport. Wrapped in HydrationBoundary for SSR.

nodes.name: CategorySection
nodes.description: Horizontal scrollable row of ProductCards for a single category. Includes "See More" card linking to the category's products page. Uses cart store addItem for add-to-cart callbacks.

nodes.name: Products Page
nodes.description: Products listing at "/products/:category?". Server-side loader prefetches first page of products infinite query. Renders responsive grid of ProductCards with "Load more" button pagination. Dynamic meta title from category slug. Wrapped in HydrationBoundary for SSR.

nodes.name: CategoryBreadcrumb
nodes.description: Breadcrumb showing "Featured Categories > {category}" with link back to home

nodes.name: Checkout Page
nodes.description: Checkout page at "/checkout". Client-side loader redirects to /products if cart is empty. clientAction simulates order placement (1s delay), clears cart, sets successfulOrder flag, shows toast, and redirects to /success. Two-column layout: order summary and shipping/payment forms.

nodes.name: Checkout Components Barrel
nodes.description: Re-exports OrderSummary, ShippingForm, PaymentForm

nodes.name: OrderItem
nodes.description: Read-only cart item display for checkout order summary -- image, title, quantity, line total

nodes.name: OrderSummary
nodes.description: Checkout order summary listing all OrderItems with subtotal, VAT (20%), and total

nodes.name: PaymentForm
nodes.description: Payment information form with card number, expiry date, and CVV fields

nodes.name: ShippingForm
nodes.description: Shipping information form with name, email, address, city, and postal code fields

nodes.name: Success Page
nodes.description: Order confirmation at "/success". Client-side loader redirects to /products unless successfulOrder flag is set in cart store (then clears it). Fires js-confetti animation on mount. Shows order number and "Continue Shopping" link.

nodes.name: Tests
nodes.description: Playwright E2E test suites

nodes.name: Products E2E Tests
nodes.description: 3 Playwright tests: display products by category (breadcrumb, card anatomy), add product to cart (toast, cart sheet, item verification), navigate between categories via nav menu.

nodes.name: Checkout E2E Tests
nodes.description: 1 Playwright test: full checkout flow -- add to cart, open cart, navigate to checkout, fill shipping and payment forms, submit order, verify success page.
